subject: Attending CVPR | quick coffee?
text:

Assuming you and the [COMPANY] team will be in Nashville for CVPR this year? Would be great to get a coffee and swap notes on the work we're doing in computer vision / multimodal model dev.

subject: Quick Hi [SENDER]
text:
Hi [NAME],

I saw you downloaded our Physical AI ebook so I wanted to reach out. We've
been following [SENDER] AI for a while now and work with many AI teams building
DICOM models, such as Highmark Health, Flatiron Health, Kaliber Labs,
Viz.ai etc.

In case Encord is new to you - our mission is to accelerate model
development starting with data. We focus on solving scalability challenges
between data curation, annotation and model evaluation, with the goals of
improving model quality and labelling throughput.

Curious to hear how you're thinking about data topics at [SENDER] AI and keen to
exchange perspectives. Let me know if you're open to a quick chat Tuesday
to Friday next week?

text:

subject: [COMPANY] & Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saw that you requested more info on our website & thought I'd reach out
personally. I lead a medical imaging team here at Encord - working closely
with teams at GE Healthcare, Philips, Perceptive, etc on medical (including
dental) segmentation for x-rays & CBCT DICOMs.

I believe my team spoke to your colleague Ju An recently & a few things
came up that might be worth exploring around visualizing / labeling 3D
series & leveraging multimodal data (CBCT DICOM, X-ray, audio/speech, Docs,
etc).

Our co-founder [SENDER] & I both began our entrepreneurial journey at the
Harvard iLabs so we're always excited to collaborate with companies who
started there as well. Would love to get your feedback on what we're
building here - would you be open to catch up at some point over the coming
weeks? Thursday/Friday generally work best for me.

subject: Huge congrats on your Series A!
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on Creatify's Series A announcement today! I understand you're
launching AdMax - we work on projects with Zefr and GumGum who's also
building contextual ad targeting models, thought it's worth having a chat.

in case Encord is new to you - our mission is to accelerate model
development starting with data. We've helped over 200 AI teams better
structure their training datasets for annotation/ human feedback & increase
labelling throughput, incl. leading teams building video generation models
like Synthesia, Captions & TwelveLabs.

Keen to understand how you're thinking about scaling your model development
efforts, and happy to share our perspectives. Let me know if you're open to
a chat Tuesday to Friday next week?
